pairs.why: The two drawings are almost the same windmill, wheat and plain sky, and I can't see a difference in finish that matters.
A's tower base is clean, while B has a blurry smudged shadow in the wheat at the foot of the tower that doesn't look like the real cards.
B adds soft clouds and a distant horizon, giving the scene depth like the real lighthouse card, while A's sky is flat and empty; the object itself is the same.
A has the soft clouds and distant horizon that match the depth of the real scenes; B's flat sky is plainer, and the windmills are the same.
B's clouds and rolling horizon read more like the staged real scenes, and its wheat is no rougher than A's.
A has the cloud and horizon depth seen on the real cards, and the windmill is rendered the same in both.
These are near duplicates with the same wheat texture, sky and windmill build, so I can't tell them apart in a meaningful way.
These are near duplicates with no visible difference in rendering, light or finish.
